title: Factual Yet One-Sided: Stance Poisoning and Evidence Balancing in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The stance expressed in responses from retrieval-augmented generation systems is significantly influenced by the stance distribution of the retrieved materials. Existing research on knowledge poisoning has primarily targeted factual errors. In contrast, this study focuses on injection attacks in which the facts are correct but the stance on a controversial issue is one-sided. At a mean topic-level poisoning share of 18.9% within the post-injection ProCon documents, all four generation models from different vendors exhibited stance shifts aligned with the poisoning direction; across four concentration levels, the shifts increased monotonically.   This paper proposes a Stance-Balancing Middleware positioned between the retriever and the generator. translated_title: 事实正确却立场偏颇：检索增强生成中的立场投毒与证据平衡
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成系统回复中所表达的立场，显著受检索材料的立场分布影响。现有关于知识投毒的研究主要针对事实性错误，而本研究关注的是一种事实正确、但在争议议题上立场片面的注入攻击。实验表明，在注入后的 ProCon 文档中话题层面平均投毒占比达到 18.9% 时，来自不同厂商的四个生成模型均表现出与投毒方向一致的立场偏移；且在四种集中度水平下，偏移呈单调递增。本文提出了一种位于检索器与生成器之间的立场平衡中间件，由立场检测、固定平衡机制（2条支持 + 2条反对 + 1条中立）以及去偏提示词构成，且不引入额外的大语言模型调用。在全部八种配置下……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了一种新型立场投毒攻击——注入事实正确但立场片面的材料即可使检索增强生成系统的输出立场随之偏移，并提出一个无需额外大模型调用的立场平衡中间件，通过立场检测、固定配比的证据平衡与去偏提示词来消除这一偏见。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a novel stance poisoning attack on retrieval-augmented generation—injecting factually correct yet one-sided materials shifts the system's stance—and proposes a stance-balancing middleware that mitigates this bias via stance detection, fixed-ratio evidence balancing, and debiasing prompts without additional LLM calls.
